output.answer: As of today (Nov 11, 2026), Tonix Pharmaceuticals' (TNXP) latest reported short interest — the FINRA/NASDAQ settlement of Oct 30, 2026 — stands at 3,318,461 shares short, about 19.4% of its ~17.1M shares outstanding, with a days-to-cover of ~4.1. That is up 12.8% (+377,753 shares) from the prior Oct 15 settlement of 2,940,708 shares (17.21%), so short sellers added to their position in the most recent period. Short interest has run high in 2026, generally between ~2.3M and ~3.6M shares (roughly 15–30% of shares outstanding) across the year's biweekly settlements.
caveats: FINRA short interest is reported on a biweekly cadence with roughly a two-week lag; the Oct 30, 2026 settlement is the latest official figure, and actual current short interest may differ (both directions) from the published number.

Aggregators differ slightly on the percentage basis and ratio: ChartExchange shows 19.42% of shares outstanding and 4.14 days to cover for Oct 30, while Finviz shows a 19.42% short float and a 4.81 short ratio, and stockanalysis.com still showed the older Oct 15 figure (2.94M shares, 15.13% of shares outstanding / 16.14% of float, 3.48 days) as of Nov 11, 2026.

The percentage of shares outstanding depends on the share count used: ChartExchange's Oct 30 row uses 17,151,024 shares outstanding, while current share counts cited by trackers are ~19.15–19.43M, which would put the same 3.32M shares short at a somewhat lower ~17% of shares outstanding.
